no_adcom_quote.quote: Not applicable. No Advisory Committee Meeting will be held regarding this application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the original Lucentis (ranibizumab) BLA 125156 approval in 2006. The Medical Review states in both the review summary (L191-192) and section 8.5 (L1203-1204) that an Advisory Committee Meeting was 'Not applicable' and would not be held. No committee concerns or resulting approval changes exist to link.
